verdict.rationale: The evidence pack contains no published per-unit prices for searches, records, or nodes. The only pricing-page excerpt says "Deploy anywhere: on-prem or in private or public cloud," and the serverless docs describe usage-based autoscaling without stating any unit rates. Community reports call the pricing model vague and say licensing costs came out of sales conversations, which points away from predictable published pricing.

support.subject: As a founder, published per-unit pricing (searches, records, or nodes) lets me predict what search will cost before committing
